description: Read one Hacker News story by ID or item URL, returning story metadata, self-post text, and a bounded nested discussion thread.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Hacker News story ID; provide exactly one of id or url.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Hacker News item URL; provide exactly one of url or id.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of live comments to return (1-200).
